source.title: Beyond Light Cones: State Preparation Complexity in Quantum Spin Glasses

novelty: Effective profile-complexity bounds based on metric entropy of p-local Pauli profiles; combines a nonsymmetric quantum de Finetti argument with Gaussian-process entropy bounds.

reported_results: Omega(n^2/log n) one- and two-qubit gate requirement in the stated near-ground-state setting
leading-order product-stabilizer benchmark for Clifford+T with o(n) T gates

limitations: not a universal lower bound for arbitrary workloads or QUBO/QAOA instances
not an independent UQPU proof reconstruction
not measured latency, energy, QPU success, provider charges, or cost per accepted task
not a classical memory-capacity result or physical law
next_gate: Pin exact theorem text, reconstruct proof assumptions, fail-closed map one candidate workload to all hypotheses, then compare resource implications with matched CPU/GPU useful-output baselines.
